dead_code_analysis.explanation: All features are infrastructure files intended for future use. They are not 'dead code' but rather 'foundation code' that will be integrated in Issue #354. The JSON Schema is actively used by the generation script, and the script successfully generates both TypeScript and Pydantic types. While the generated types are not yet actively used in production code, this is by design for this phase of the project.

details: Phase 1: Update graphAiServer to import from schemas/generated/taskflow.d.ts instead of types/taskflow.ts
Phase 2: Update expertAgent workflow generation to use generated Pydantic models
Phase 3: Deprecate manual type definitions in favor of generated types
recommended_actions.note: This is the next planned issue and is expected behavior for Issue #357

conclusion.explanation: Issue #357 successfully delivers JSON Schema Single Source of Truth infrastructure. All acceptance criteria are met: (1) workflow.schema.json exists and is valid Draft 2020-12, (2) generate_schemas.py generates TypeScript types, (3) generate_schemas.py generates Pydantic models, (4) all generated files are correctly formatted and importable, (5) comprehensive unit tests verify all functionality. The generated types are infrastructure for future integration (Issue #354), not dead code.
